item.title: Woman, toddler killed in Las Vegas valley double homicide; no suspect arrested
item.description: A woman and a toddler were shot and killed in a south Las Vegas valley double homicide Monday night.

item.title: Man accused of killing man while attempting to rob him of his gun at Las Vegas intersection
item.description: A man is accused of shooting and killing a man while attempting to rob him of his firearm at a Las Vegas intersection, according to an arrest report.

item.title: PHOTOS: Total lunar eclipse seen from Las Vegas
item.description: In the early morning hours of Tuesday, March 3, people across the planet, including right here in Las Vegas, looked up at the sky and were able to see the total lunar eclipse.

item.title: 2 dead, 1 hospitalized in North Las Vegas shooting
item.description: Two men are dead and another was hospitalized in a shooting in North Las Vegas early Tuesday morning.
